newsitem.title: GERMANY: German network RTL holds onto market lead in Feb.
newsitem.headline: German network RTL holds onto market lead in Feb.

text.p: The RTL network remained the German television ratings leader in February, television advertising marketing group IP Germany said on Wednesday.
The Cologne-based broadcaster once again captured a 16 percent market share, according to figures provided to IP Germany by the GfK television research group.
Public broadcaster ARD jumped to second place from third in January with 15.2 percent, marking a nearly one percent leap in a month's time.

IP Germany reported that viewing time in a sitting among surveyed households had dropped by ten minutes from January to 205 minutes per day, a higher rate than the 183-minute average network ZDF's media research division announced on Monday.

Among adult viewers, RTL also topped the ranks, ahead of Pro Sieben with 14.7 percent which suffered half percent dips both among adult viewers and in viewing time, although it did continue to lead among smaller networks.
RTL2 held second place among the smaller players, after Pro Sieben but gained nearly a percentage point since January to a 4.4 percent market share.
Kabel 1 with 3.9 percent and Super RTL at 2.2 percent each saw a tenth of a percentage point shaved off their shares in February. Vox remained in a holding pattern with its three percent share.
